verdict.rationale: Unit is a banking-as-a-service and financial infrastructure platform, offering accounts, payments, cards and lending via APIs. It is not an AI agent or assistant that consumes tools, so acting as an MCP client is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows Unit embedding any agent that could connect to MCP servers.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
